project_type: Infrastructure-as-Code project deploying NVIDIA NIM (Llama 3.1 8B) - migrating from EKS to SageMaker
build_system: Terraform for infrastructure, bash scripts for deployment, Python for load testing
test_framework: No automated tests - validation is done via terraform validate and script syntax checks
build_command: cd terraform && terraform init && terraform validate
verification_instructions: 1. Run terraform validate on the terraform/ directory. 2. Run python -m py_compile on load_test.py. 3. Run bash -n on deploy.sh for syntax check.
setup_instructions: No local setup needed beyond having terraform, python3 available
environment_constraints: Open internet access. No actual AWS deployment will be done - validation is syntax/structure only.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. The repo uses a GitHub Actions workflow for automated review on PRs touching terraform/, k8s/, and scripts/ paths.
key_patterns: Terraform uses community modules (terraform-aws-modules). Scripts use set -euo pipefail. Load test uses asyncio/aiohttp. K8s manifests are plain YAML applied via kubectl.
directory_structure: terraform/ - IaC for AWS infra; k8s/ - Kubernetes manifests for NIM; scripts/ - deploy.sh and load_test.py; .github/workflows/ - CI review workflow
